name: Morning digest
goal: Summarize today's calendar and save a short morning digest note in the workspace.

collect.description: Read today's events from the device calendar

prompt.text: Use calendar_list_events to list today's calendar events. Return a plain-text list with start time, title, and location for each event, in chronological order. If there are no events today, reply exactly: No events today.

summarize.description: Turn the raw event list into a short digest

prompt.text:
Turn this schedule into a short morning digest: one headline line, then a bullet per event, then one line naming the most important item of the day.

{{collect.output}}

write_note.description: Save the digest as a note in the workspace

prompt.text:
Save the digest below to home/notes/morning-digest.md using write_file (overwrite if it exists). Then reply with the saved path followed by the digest itself.

{{summarize.output}}
